positive.name: Browse by two major colors
positive.prompt: Use World Flag Map to show me countries whose flags have green and yellow.
positive.expectedBehavior: Activate explore-world-flags, search major flag colors in the bundled catalog, summarize useful matches, and include the complete tracked atlas link.
positive.expectedResultShape: A concise country list plus a worldflagmap.com URL with colors=green,yellow and plugin UTM parameters.
positive.fixtures: Bundled countries.json; no account or external service required.

positive.name: Indirect continent and dominant-color discovery
positive.prompt: Which European countries have mostly blue flags?
positive.expectedBehavior: Activate explore-world-flags, filter Europe and dominant blue from the bundled snapshot, explain that color families are generated classifications, and link to the visual atlas.
positive.expectedResultShape: A concise list with a tracked continent/color atlas link.
positive.fixtures: Bundled countries.json; no account or external service required.

positive.name: Compare two countries
positive.prompt: Compare Japan and South Korea by flag colors, capital, language, currency, and population.
positive.expectedBehavior: Activate explore-world-flags, resolve both records, include the population year, and link both country pages.
positive.expectedResultShape: A compact two-country comparison table and two tracked country-page links.
positive.fixtures: Bundled countries.json; no account or external service required.

positive.name: Start a regional flag quiz
positive.expectedBehavior: Activate explore-world-flags, stay in an ordinary chat message rather than creating a native quiz experience, attach the bundled PNG flag with neutral visible text, provide exactly four unique country-name-only choices with one correct answer, and wait without revealing the country. Do not place flag emoji or images beside answer choices.
positive.expectedResultShape: A plain chat response with a score heading, one visible mystery flag or usable flag fallback link, one question, country-name-only choices A through D, and no answer reveal before the user guesses.
positive.fixtures: Bundled countries.json and bundled flag PNGs; no account or external service required.

positive.name: Open the country outline game
positive.prompt: I want a game where I guess a country from its outline and location.
positive.expectedBehavior: Activate explore-world-flags, identify Map Challange as the matching game, briefly describe it, and provide the tracked game link.
positive.expectedResultShape: A short recommendation and a tracked worldflagmap.com/games/map-challange/ URL.
positive.fixtures: No account or external service required.

negative.name: Travel booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Japan next Friday.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not activate World Flag Map or claim to book travel; leave the request to a travel-capable workflow.
negative.reason: The plugin provides static flag and country exploration, not travel transactions.

negative.name: Custom flag design is out of scope
negative.prompt: Design a new flag and logo for my company.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not activate World Flag Map; use an image or design capability instead if available.
negative.reason: The plugin describes existing national flags and does not generate brand artwork.

negative.name: Live demographic prediction is unsupported
negative.prompt: Predict India's exact population on this date next year.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not invent or extrapolate an exact future value; explain that World Flag Map only has a dated population snapshot and use a more suitable source if the user requests forecasting.
negative.reason: The bundled catalog is historical static data, not a demographic forecast model.
